name: Cham performances
nameVi: Biểu diễn văn hóa dân gian Chăm
kicker: Daytime Cham dance and singing in the valley
summary: Daytime Cham dance in the valley: catch a hall slot or the 09:00 and 14:45 show at group G. Bad weather can stop the outdoor show. The evening performance has no fixed date. Skip it if you only came for the brick.
dotReason: Worth timing if you are already in the valley, not a separate trip
getThere: In the valley after the cart. 45 km by road from Hoi An
heroCaption: Cham dancers at a performance in My Son

notice.title: The evening show has no fixed date
notice.body: Đêm Mỹ Sơn huyền thoại plays inside the grounds, with sound and light. The calendar follows dates when large groups are present. Confirm a night before you stay for it.

body: The daytime clock is three places, on the same ticket as the towers. The hall runs at 09:45, 10:30, 11:15, 14:00, and 16:00, every day unless it is cancelled for operations. At the foot of group G the show is 09:00 and 14:45, and bad weather can stop that one. Group G is the Italian restoration: a survey from 1997 to 2000, then Italian funding with UNESCO’s backing. That group also uses laterite. Cham folk singing is Monday, Wednesday, and Friday at the group H slope, at those same two hours.

On the 15th, Echoes of My Son is the program in groups B, C, and D, at 09:00 and 14:45. The program uses ginang and paranung drums, the saranai, a fan dance, a water-carrying dance, and Cham folk song. A folk performance is part of the entrance ticket. Ask before you count on the monthly show sitting inside that ticket.

Đêm Mỹ Sơn huyền thoại is the evening show, inside the monument grounds, with sound and light, in three parts: Thung lũng câu chuyện thời gian, Đêm Mỹ Sơn huyền thoại, and Ánh sáng chan hòa. The calendar is unfixed. Plan the night only after you have a date. Food stays outside the monument area. Sleep in Hoi An.

figures.caption: Group G, where the 09:00 and 14:45 show is held
figures.alt: Brick towers of group G at My Son, with trees behind the ruins

gettingThere: The hall, group G, and the group H slope are in the valley, after the cart. Cars stop at the museum. The cart covers about 2 km along the Khe Thẻ stream, and that ride is inside the entrance ticket. Tourism bus 01DL, from Hoi An, is paused for six months from 15 Sep 2026.

legs.heading: From Hoi An
legs.body: By road to the museum, then the cart, 45 km. Hire a car. Bus 01DL is paused from 15 Sep 2026 for six months.

legs.heading: From the museum
legs.body: The electric cart runs about 2 km toward the towers. The carts run from the museum toward the Nhà Đôi area. The hall and group G are in that valley.

hours: Hall at 09:45, 10:30, 11:15, 14:00, and 16:00. Group G at 09:00 and 14:45. Cham folk singing at the group H slope at 09:00 and 14:45 on Monday, Wednesday, and Friday. The gate opens at 06:00. Ticket sales run until 17:30. Visiting ends at 18:00.
closed: The hall runs every day unless it is cancelled for operations. Bad weather can stop the show at group G. Singing at the group H slope is Monday, Wednesday, and Friday. The evening show has no published night.
admissionNote: No separate daytime price is listed. A non-resident adult is listed at 150,000 VND and a Vietnamese adult at 100,000 VND, including VAT. The purchase page showed 148,000 VND and 99,000 VND on 21 Oct 2026. Read the amount before you pay. A folk performance is part of the entrance ticket. Children from 5 to 15 buy the 30,000 VND shuttle ticket. Children under 5 are free. Echoes of My Son and the evening show: Check on arrival. The evening show has no published 2026 price and no fixed night.
